notes.title: Space Update!
notes.content:
- Now it's really only one try to finish the tower
- However there are buttons in the menu corresponding to levels through 2 to 6 with altars which will return you to them resetting the level
- 6th level is the only level which will take you to the altar upon defeat instead of taking you all the way to the beggining.
- Instead of character list there is a Golscar spaceship hub now
- added Golscar, as the first NPC
- added a new collectable item - audio tapes, they tell stories of the planet's past. You can listen to them on the spaceship.
- Added haste (press B to use) and invulnerability (press I to use) bonuses, each lasting for four seconds
- New helmet interface, each health bar has its own opaqueness, increasing when your health bar lowers
- Button H drops your health threshold to 1 hp
- Added energy bar of the knight's suit
- Each suit's energy reserve is enough for 9 minutes, you loose if you run out of energy
- Added batteries, charging you for 50 seconds
- Whenever you make a hit you loose 5 seconds
- If your hit connects you restore 5 seconds back
- Added space
- Added portal capsules, which are dropped by Golscar with the intent of trying to make your journey shorter
- Portals can be encountered starting from the fourth balcony
- Portals transfer you to one of the asteroids near the planet, which will have another portal, transferring you back to the tower
- You'll encounter Nitmofeds on the asteroid and Nitmofed mountain at the end
- You can be hit by space debris while on the asteroid
- Removed descending the stairway sound
- Removed the sound of the wind
- Changed hero animation speed
- Changed hero movement speed
- Each knight has their own unique mechanic now
- Now rhino goes faster the longer you hold down the movement button, it's his new unique ability: charge
- The bee has "honey pillow" which protects it from lower traps but makes it go slower than other knights
- When you appear in the tower a unique teleportation animation will play out, unique for each knight
- Added first twenty visuals
- Renewed bestiary

notes.title: Patch 0.06 [beta]
notes.content:
- instead of the exit button to the main menu, there is now a cog button that opens a menu window that allows you to restart the level, continue playing and exit to the main menu
- the "bestiary" button has now appeared in the main menu, where you can find all existing enemies and their health
- whenever you loose or complete the level, a special window will appear
- now each book in the "lore" and "bestiary" section has its own cross that closes the window
- now in the "lore" section above each arrow it is indicated which book it switches you to
- now your character has a built-in mini-map in the helmet showing which block of the tower you are in
